_about: Manual review of every non-contained result, after the run. It never changes a measured result; it says how to read it. kind: confirmed (the contract's failure, observed as described) | contract-assumption (the contract's success signal does not mean a breach for this sandbox's design) | kernel-dependent (needs a newer Landlock ABI than this host's 4) | documented (the sandbox documents this limitation) | interface (the sandbox works differently than the contract's control assumes).

read-deny-link-dotdot: The deny is resolved lexically: here/up -> link/../file is folded to here/file, so here/file is denied (control fails) and the real target elsewhere/file is read (attack printed TOPSECRET).
write-deny-dangling-link-target: Writing through the denied dangling link created its eventual target elsewhere/made.
write-deny-link-dotdot: srt hung until the runner's 60 s timeout (exit 137) for both attack and control; fails closed, but unusable.
read-deny-bracket-dir: srt exits before running anything: 'Invalid regular expression ... [user-id] ... Range out of order'. Fails closed.
network-egress-public-denied: A granted loopback port is reachable only through srt's proxy (measured: HTTP 200 with curl --noproxy ''). The control connects directly, and srt sets NO_PROXY=127.0.0.1, so it fails; the attack was contained.
network-local-bind-denied: The listener is bound inside srt's own empty network namespace, which no host process can reach; the contract's concern (an inbound channel from the host) does not arise. The control failed for the same proxy reason as network-egress-public-denied.
network-tcp-external-denied: The contract counts any error other than EPERM/EACCES as success. Under srt the process has no network interface at all (ENETUNREACH); nothing can leave the host.
isolation-process-info-foreign: /proc/1 inside srt is the sandbox's own init in its private PID namespace, not a host process.
network-other-socket-families-denied: AF_NETLINK/AF_VSOCK sockets can be created. In srt's empty network namespace netlink only sees that namespace; AF_VSOCK is not namespaced. Whether vsock reaches anything on this host: (por confirmar).
network-vsock-denied: AF_VSOCK socket creation allowed; reachability on this host (por confirmar).
network-socket-domain-high-bits: Socket creation with high bits set in the domain argument is not refused by srt's filter (which targets AF_UNIX).
secrets-env-loader-injection-inherit: The policy asks to inherit the launcher's whole environment, and the sandbox did exactly that (LD_PRELOAD/BASH_ENV passed). The contract's own comment calls stripping loader variables even under inherit-all a design decision still to be made, not an established guarantee.

ipc-abstract-unix-socket: Abstract-socket scoping needs Landlock ABI 6 (kernel 6.12+); this host has ABI 4 and nono logs it as unavailable.
isolation-signal-host-process: Signal scoping needs Landlock ABI 6 (kernel 6.12+); this host has ABI 4.
filesystem-chmod-outside: Measured with a read grant on the test tree (the neutral read-everything baseline). Landlock does not mediate chmod/utime/xattr, so a readable file's metadata can be changed. Under nono's own idiom (no grant at all) the file would be unreachable.
lifecycle-background-reaped-on-exit: A background child outlived the sandboxed command and wrote the marker.
lifecycle-signal-teardown: SIGTERM to the launcher ended it (143), but the sandboxed tree survived and wrote the marker.
fs-writable-root-symlink-out: A writable root that is itself a symlink pointing outside the other roots was followed, so its target became writable. The contract pins a policy decision (refuse such a root); the sandbox does not make it.
fs-writable-root-symlink-parent: A writable root that is itself a symlink pointing outside the other roots was followed, so its target became writable. The contract pins a policy decision (refuse such a root); the sandbox does not make it.

isolation-process-info-foreign: /proc/1 inside codex's sandbox is its own init in a private PID namespace, not a host process.
lifecycle-signal-teardown: After SIGTERM to `codex sandbox`, the sandboxed tree kept running and wrote the marker.
write-deny-covers-nested-root: A writable root nested inside a write-denied directory stayed writable; codex resolves overlapping entries by the most specific path.
read-deny-symlink-entry: Fails closed: bwrap cannot mount over a deny entry that is a symlink, so nothing runs.

The contract's own comment calls stripping loader variables even under inherit-all a design decision still to be made, not an established guarantee.
